sources.title: Decision
sources.text: We did not approve the PostgreSQL migration. SQLite remains the current database.

sources.title: Cache discussion
sources.text: Asha proposed Redis on November 5. The proposal is still unapproved; no cache has been selected.

sources.title: Checklist
sources.text: - [ ] Mira must test restore from backup before release. This test has not been completed.

sources.title: Workshop plan
sources.text: The workshop is scheduled for 2026-11-14. The budget ceiling is 20000 rupees, and only 12 seats are confirmed.

sources.title: Storage
sources.text: We chose SQLite for local storage.

sources.title: Network
sources.text: We chose HTTPS for remote requests. These choices address separate parts of the application.
